name: Hul
overview: Hul is a male figure mentioned in Scripture as the son of Aram. Beyond this genealogical note, the Bible does not provide further details about his tribe or additional attributes. His mention situates him within the broader genealogical framework of Genesis 10.
namesAndTitles: The name Hul appears as a proper name in the biblical record without an explicit meaning or divine origin noted. It is simply recorded as the name of this individual in Genesis 10:23.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly identifies Hul as a son of Aram, establishing a direct father-son relationship. No other family relationships are recorded in the biblical text concerning Hul.
scriptureSignificance: Hul's significance lies primarily in his role within the genealogical listings of Genesis 10, which trace the descendants of Noah's sons following the flood. As a son of Aram, Hul contributes to the biblical account of the nations' origins and God's providential unfolding of history through family lines.
